review_scope: Read-only source and retained evidence review; no downloads, service capture, native oracle reruns, or new payload authentication

findings.detail: Resume indexes only acquisition.json but prior resume writes acquisition-resume-N.json; a second resume refuses previously created later bodies instead of adopting exact verified receipt-chain identities. Existing partial comparison remains valid. Owner A confirmed and is implementing receipt-chain revalidation; no concurrent writer or overwrite is authorized.

safety_review: Native resource stream is bounded by COH_RESOURCE_INPUT_MAX and COH_RESOURCE_ROWS_MAX before source views; source record grammar remains delegated to the qualified bounded parser. TSV entries cap at 512, line extent 8192, candidate mounted body at16MiB; resource index admits one GEO at a time with immutable retained blob/header workspace. Early host CLI failures exit without publishing an index or generation permit.

Header getter finds exact retained owner, rejects absent/no-model owners without touching output, and borrows the already retained immutable GEO workspace until index retirement. It adds no allocations or admission state. Output must be disjoint, as documented.

Acquirer reads exact bounded ZIP ranges through the preserved helper, verifies selected payload size/SHA and ZIP CRC, and creates files exclusively. Its range ETag and selected-body SHA prove selected downloaded bytes, not full archive or runtime generation identity.

Body comparison checks model names, sorted runtime rank versus disk row, version, vertex/triangle counts and texture partitions through the resource index. It does not compare source trick/bounds/scale/CLIENT state, nor prove the runtime opened this exact body.

The observed 52,856,702-byte peak is named native reservation accounting, not complete process RSS or world-publication budget. Python source/body rehash stages and native CLI inputs are qualified only for the exact pinned candidate report and retained capture; arbitrary attacker-controlled documents are outside this evidence.
